description:
Use this tool when the user explicitly asks to publish social media content immediately. It publishes the supplied b2s_posts to the connected social media account identified by client_user_network_id. This action publishes content directly and does not create a draft or schedule a post for later publication.

postFormat must be:
- 0 for text or link
- 1 for image
- 2 for video

Image and video posts require mediaObjects with the matching IMAGE or VIDEO type and a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Check networks.properties before publishing to verify the requirements for the selected network and account type.

The response can include:
- publish_url for retrieving post performance insights with posts.insights
- video_token for checking video publication status with videos.status

Evaluate all returned error fields, including b2s_error_code. Do not automatically retry uncertain publishing operations.

b2s_posts.description: One or more posts to publish to the selected account. Use postFormat 0 for text or links, 1 for images, and 2 for videos; image and video posts require mediaObjects.

customUrl.description: Optional public URL attached to the post.

message.description: Text of the social media post.

title.description: Optional title for the post, when supported by the selected social network.

customUrl.description: Optional public URL to attach to the image post, when supported by the selected social network.

mediaObjects.description: Image media items to include in the post. Each item must provide an IMAGE type and a public URL.

alt.description: Optional alternative text describing the image.

type.description: Media type; must be IMAGE for this post.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS image URL.

message.description: Text or caption to accompany the image post.

title.description: Optional title for the image post, when supported by the selected social network.

customUrl.description: Optional public URL to attach to the video post, when supported by the selected social network.

mediaObjects.description: Video media items to include in the post. Each item must have type VIDEO and a public HTTP or HTTPS URL.

alt.description: Optional alternative text or description for the video.

type.description: Media type; must be VIDEO for this post.

url.description: Required public HTTP or HTTPS video URL.

message.description: Text or caption to accompany the video post.

title.description: Optional title for the video post, when supported by the selected social network.

client_user_network_id.description: Connected social media account ID returned by connections.list. All posts in b2s_posts are published to this account.

name: posts.publish_post
title: Publish a post immediately
